src: Stále sa lopty dotýkal vonkajšou stranou kopačky.
ref: He kept touching the ball with the outside of his boot.
clause: Stále sa lopty dotýkal vonkajšou stranou kopačky

src: Ak chceš vyhrať, mal by si trénovať v blate.
ref: If you want to win, you should train in the mud.
clause: mal by si trénovať v blate

src: Zatlieskala, lebo každý model si vyrobil sám.
ref: She clapped because he made every model himself.

src: Ak si takto smutný, mal by si zavolať kamarátke.
ref: If you feel this sad, you should call a good friend.

src: Predtým, ako utrela pracovnú dosku, postriekala špinavý sporák penou.
ref: Before she wiped the worktop, she had sprayed the dirty stove with foam.

src: Kámoška, povedal mi, že by si prial, keby bol opravil to umývadlo už minulý týždeň, nie dnes.
ref: Bestie, he told me he wishes he had fixed that sink last week, not today.

src: Poviem na rovinu, ty točíš 2 filmy jednou malou kamerou? Rešpekt.
ref: Not gonna lie, you make 2 movies with one small camera? Respect.

src: Mohol sa ma najprv opýtať, ale ten klobúk si jednoducho nasadil
ref: He could have asked me first, but he just put the hat on.

src: Stále menil smer, kým obranca nespadol.
ref: He kept changing direction until the defender fell over.

src: Kiežby moje izbovky mali také silné korene ako tamtá.
ref: I wish my houseplants had roots as strong as that one's.
clause: Kiežby moje izbovky mali také silné korene ako tamtá

src: Stále kráčal hore chodníkom, hoci hmla hustla.
ref: He kept walking up the path even though the fog was getting thicker.

src: Ak chceš dobrú známku, mal by si si prečítať poznámky.
ref: If you want a good grade, you should read your notes.
clause: mal by si si prečítať poznámky

src: V stodole je ticho. Hovorí: Nechám viac syra.
ref: The barn is quiet. She says: I will leave more cheese.

src: Pozrel sa dole a čakal, kým ho popruhy pustia.
ref: He looked down and waited for the straps to release him.

src: Keď ho popruhy pustili, už dlho sa pozeral dole na oblaky.
ref: When the straps released him, he had been looking down at the clouds for a long time.
clause: už dlho sa pozeral dole na oblaky

src: Nechcela vyliať mlieko, že nie?
ref: She didn't mean to spill the milk, did she?

src: Mala skontrolovať krabicu, než vyliala všetko to mlieko.
ref: She should have checked the carton before she spilled all that milk.

src: Počuj, povedala mi, že obchod s bábikami má málo miesta.
ref: Listen, she told me the doll shop has little space.

src: Zlatko, vravela, že za tou staršou paňou kráčalo veľa susedov.
ref: Bestie, she said many neighbours walked behind the elderly lady.

src: Mal by si zvoniť na ten zvonček hlasnejšie, fakt. Celé bistro to miluje.
ref: You should ring that bell louder, honestly. The whole diner loves it.
clause: Mal by si zvoniť na ten zvonček hlasnejšie

src: Police po nákupe naplnia rýchlo
ref: They fill the shelves quickly after the shopping.

src: Police po nákupe naplnia rýchlo
ref: They will fill the shelves quickly after the shopping.

src: Brácho, chce byť fotograf, tak včera schmatol ten fotoaparát.
ref: Bro, he's tryna be a photographer, so yesterday he grabbed the camera.

src: Nebudem klamať, vyzeráš štýlovo len s jedným kusom nábytku.
ref: Not gonna lie, you look cool with just one piece of furniture.

src: Kedysi veríval, že list nikoho iného nezaujíma - a vtedy úradníčka siahla po valčeku.
ref: He used to believe that a letter was nobody else's business - then the clerk reached for her roller.

src: Hádaj čo, povedala, že brankár práve teraz robí rýchly skok.
ref: Guess what, she said the goalkeeper is doing a quick dive right now.

src: Naliala vodu z džbánu so zahnutým uchom do krhly.
ref: She poured water from the jug with the curved handle into the watering can.
clause: Naliala vodu z džbánu so zahnutým uchom do krhly

src: Nebudem klamať, už si pripevnil tri vlajky na tú mapu. Ikonický cestovateľský vkus.
ref: Not gonna lie, you have stuck three flags on that map already. Iconic travel taste.

src: Nebudem klamať, nakrájaš toľko zeleniny za pár sekúnd.
ref: Not gonna lie, you chop so many vegetables in seconds.

src: Neprekážalo mu zdieľať izbu s ôsmimi cudzími ľuďmi.
ref: He didn't mind sharing a room with eight strangers.
clause: Neprekážalo mu zdieľať izbu s ôsmimi cudzími ľuďmi

src: Povedal, že stopky ukázali jej najrýchlejší čas v živote.
ref: He said the stopwatch had shown her fastest time ever.

src: Pred skladaním by si mal nechať syr roztopiť.
ref: You should let the cheese melt before you stack it.
clause: Pred skladaním by si mal nechať syr roztopiť

src: Kým jej mačka skočila na kolená, oči už mala zavreté
ref: By the time the cat jumped onto her lap, she had already closed her eyes.

src: Zháňal zásuvku, keď zrazu ukázala na stenu za monsterou.
ref: He was hunting for a socket when she suddenly pointed at the wall behind the monstera.

src: Nemal nechať powerbanku doma - jedno percento nie je nikoho predstava o pokojnej kávičke.
ref: He shouldn't have left his power bank at home - one percent is nobody's idea of a relaxing coffee.
clause: Nemal nechať powerbanku doma jedno percento nie je nikoho predstava o pokojnej kávičke

src: Podlahu suší svojím vlastným mopom.
ref: She dries the floor with her own mop.

src: Nového nevlastného brata už objal trikrát a fotka ešte nie je odfotená.
ref: He has hugged his new stepbrother three times already, and the photo hasn't been taken yet.
clause: Nového nevlastného brata už objal trikrát a fotka ešte nie je odfotená

src: Keď si to ráno obliekal oblek, netušil, že do obeda bude mať nevlastného brata.
ref: When he put on his suit that morning, he had no idea he would have a stepbrother by lunchtime.

src: Smejú sa, keď si berú kľúče, takže sa im byt, ktorý si prezreli, musel páčiť.
ref: They are laughing as they take the keys, so they must have liked the flat they viewed.

src: Najhoršia noc vôbec! Utešovala ho na gauči a ostatní tiež.
ref: The worst night ever! She consoled him on the sofa, and so did the others.
clause: Utešovala ho na gauči a ostatní tiež

src: Kamaráti ho mali utešiť skôr; celé hodiny plakal sám.
ref: His friends should have consoled him earlier; he had been crying alone for hours.

src: Hneď očervenela, takže ten kompliment musel byť veľmi milý.
ref: She went pink at once, so the compliment must have been very sweet.

src: Normálne zaostruje na kvety. Včera zaostrovala na strechy, samozrejme.
ref: She normally focuses on flowers. Yesterday she focused on roofs, obviously.

src: Baby, povedal mi, že do budúceho leta sokol už roztiahne krídla v 100 vystúpeniach.
ref: Girl, he told me that by next summer the falcon will have spread its wings in 100 shows.

src: Pred veľkými zápasmi nebývala taká emotívna, ale dnes večer plače.
ref: She didn't use to be so emotional before big matches, but tonight she cries.
clause: Pred veľkými zápasmi nebývala taká emotívna

src: Úprimne, celé javisko si mal za pár sekúnd pokryté lístkami. Ikonické.
ref: Honestly, you had the whole stage covered in petals in seconds. Iconic.
clause: celé javisko si mal za pár sekúnd pokryté lístkami

src: Kamoška, povedal mi pravidlo jazera: ty musíš relaxovať bez mobilu.
ref: Girl, he told me the lake rule: you have to relax with no phone.

src: Nechal klimatizáciu schladiť celý byt za minútu. Jasne malá požiadavka.
ref: He had the air conditioner cool the whole flat in a minute. Clearly a small request.
clause: Nechal klimatizáciu schladiť celý byt za minútu

src: Kefu pretiahla cez veľký uzol.
ref: She pulled the brush through the big tangle.

src: Včera dočítala celú knihu.
ref: Yesterday she finished the whole book.

src: Kým sa kamera rozbehla, celú choreografiu už prešla dvakrát.
ref: By the time the camera started, she had already run through the routine twice.

src: Kým sa začne film, presunie na tú jednu malú lavicu každý vankúš v byte.
ref: By the time the film starts, he will have moved every cushion in the flat onto that one little bench.
clause: presunie na tú jednu malú lavicu každý vankúš v byte

src: Nočná mora! Stále pozeral do tabletu, zatiaľ čo postava stála priamo za ním.
ref: A nightmare! He kept watching his tablet while the figure stood right behind him.

src: Tanier je horúci. Hovorí: Vezmem ho.
ref: The plate is hot. She says: I will take it.

src: Tanier je horúci. Hovorí: Vezmem ho.
ref: The plate is hot. She says: I am going to take it.

src: Pozri, práve si obtáča šál okolo krku.
ref: Look, she is putting a scarf around her neck now.
clause: práve si obtáča šál okolo krku

src: Včera napísala tú istú esej za desať minút.
ref: Yesterday she typed the same essay in ten minutes.
clause: Včera napísala tú istú esej za desať minút

src: Keď si online kupovala lístok, netušila, že ju sklenená podlaha donúti stuhnúť.
ref: Booking the ticket online, she never thought a glass floor would make her freeze.

src: Včera nakreslila kruh na pláži.
ref: Yesterday she drew a circle on the beach.

src: Cítil sa vítaný, hneď ako prišiel k vyrezávanej drevenej bráne.
ref: He felt welcome as soon as he arrived at the carved wooden gate.

src: Rohové zástavky si dal vymeniť ešte pred prvým hvizdom.
ref: He had the corner flags replaced before the first whistle.
clause: Rohové zástavky si dal vymeniť ešte pred prvým hvizdom

src: Vedela, že ten šíp zasiahne stred vo chvíli, keď opustil tetivu.
ref: She knew that arrow would hit the centre the moment it left the string.

src: Keď vošla na trh, netušila, že odíde von s dvoma metrami zlatej potlače.
ref: Walking into the market, she had no idea she would walk out with two metres of gold print.

src: Keď prídeš dnu, mal by si zatvoriť dvere.
ref: You should shut the door when you come inside.

src: Povedala skupine, že západ slnka je najlepší čas na sedenie.
ref: She told the group the sunset was the best time to sit.

src: Rozhodla sa obliecť si dúhový perový kostým na čele sprievodu.
ref: She chose to wear the rainbow feather costume at the front of the parade.
clause: Rozhodla sa obliecť si dúhový perový kostým na čele sprievodu

src: Nezastavil sa, aby si pozrel katedrálu, a ani holuby. Skvelá prehliadka.
ref: He didn't stop to look at the cathedral, and neither did the pigeons. Great sightseeing.

src: Kamoška, povedala, že by chcela, aby jej byt mal stodolu s koňom.
ref: Girl, she said she wishes her flat had a barn with a horse in it.

src: Som celkom ohromená: ty musíš byť s návodmi úžasný; skriňa stála tak rýchlo.
ref: Kind of impressed: you must be amazing with instructions; the wardrobe went up so fast.

src: Odpadky pozbierala sama, hoci to nebola jej práca.
ref: She picked up the trash herself even though it was not her job.

src: Ak ho chceš vidieť, mal by si prísť pri západe slnka.
ref: If you want to see it, you should come at sunset.
clause: mal by si prísť pri západe slnka

src: Nebudem klamať, ty si skutočný futbalový fanúšik.
ref: Not gonna lie, you are a true football fan.

src: Vždy vedel, že sa raz stane občanom tejto krajiny.
ref: He always knew that one day he would become a citizen of this country.

src: Zabalila už dvanásť lízatiek, takže kytica je takmer plná.
ref: She has wrapped twelve lollipops already, so the bouquet is almost full.

src: Nočná mora! Ona spí v hniezde a on civí!
ref: Nightmare! She is asleep in the nest and he stares!
clause: Ona spí v hniezde a on civí

src: Nočná mora! Ona spí v hniezde a on civí!
ref: Nightmare! She is sleeping in the nest and he stares!
clause: Ona spí v hniezde a on civí

src: Sľúbil kamarátom, že otvorí šampanské vo chvíli, keď sa slnko dotkne strechy.
ref: He promised his friends that he would open the champagne the moment the sun touched the roofline.
